actions.create_entry.description: Creates a new entry in a form.
actions.create_entry.props.formId.descri: Pick the form. Only forms the API key has access to are listed.
actions.create_entry_ai.description: Creates a new entry from a form ID and a JSON object of field values.
actions.create_entry_ai.props.fields.des: Field values keyed by field name, for example {"Name": {"First": "Ada", "Last": "Lovelace"}, "Email": "ada@example.com"}.
actions.create_entry_ai.props.form_id.de: The form ID or internal name, as returned by "List Forms".
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_entry.description: Permanently deletes an entry. Entries that are already gone are reported as already deleted.
actions.delete_entry.props.entryId.descr: The entry number (for example 12) or the full entry ID (for example 5-12) of the entry to delete.
actions.delete_entry.props.formId.descri: Pick the form. Only forms the API key has access to are listed.
actions.delete_entry_ai.description: Permanently deletes an entry from a form ID and an entry ID.
actions.delete_entry_ai.props.entry_id.d: The entry number (for example 12) or the full entry ID (for example 5-12).
actions.delete_entry_ai.props.form_id.de: The form ID or internal name, as returned by "List Forms".
actions.download_file.description: Downloads a file uploaded to an entry (from a File Upload or Signature field).
actions.download_file.props.file_id.desc: The "Id" of an uploaded file or a signature's PngFile from an entry.
actions.get_entry.description: Gets an entry by its number or ID.
actions.get_entry.props.entryId.descript: The entry number (for example 12) or the full entry ID (for example 5-12).
actions.get_entry.props.formId.descripti: Pick the form. Only forms the API key has access to are listed.
actions.get_entry_ai.description: Gets an entry from a form ID and an entry ID.
actions.get_entry_ai.props.entry_id.desc: The entry number (for example 12) or the full entry ID (for example 5-12).
actions.get_entry_ai.props.form_id.descr: The form ID or internal name, as returned by "List Forms".
actions.get_entry_document.description: Generates a document (PDF or Word) for an entry from one of the form's document templates.
actions.get_entry_document.props.entry_i: The entry number (for example 12) or the full entry ID (for example 5-12).
actions.get_entry_document.props.form_id: The form ID or internal name, as returned by "List Forms".
actions.get_entry_document.props.templat: The document template number (the first template is 1).
actions.get_form_schema.description: Gets the fields of a form: names, types and which are required or read-only.
actions.get_form_schema.props.form_id.de: The form ID or internal name, as returned by "List Forms".
actions.list_forms.description: Lists the forms the API key can access.
actions.set_form_availability.descriptio: Opens or closes a form's public link for a date range. Leave both dates empty to make the form always available.
When the form stops accepting entries. Leave empty for no end limit.
actions.set_form_availability.props.form: The form ID or internal name, as returned by "List Forms".
actions.set_form_availability.props.mess: Shown to people who open the form outside the availability window.
actions.set_form_availability.props.star: When the form starts accepting entries. Empty means no start limit.
actions.update_entry.description: Updates an existing entry. Fields you leave empty keep their current value.
actions.update_entry.props.entryId.descr: The entry number (for example 12) or the full entry ID (for example 5-12). You can map it from a trigger or a "Create Entry" step.
actions.update_entry.props.formId.descri: Pick the form. Only forms the API key has access to are listed.
actions.update_entry_ai.description: Updates an entry from a form ID, an entry ID and a JSON object of field values.
actions.update_entry_ai.props.entry_id.d: The entry number (for example 12) or the full entry ID (for example 5-12).
actions.update_entry_ai.props.fields.des: Field values to change, keyed by field name. Fields not listed keep their value; null or "" clears a field.
actions.update_entry_ai.props.form_id.de: The form ID or internal name, as returned by "List Forms".
auth.description:
1. Sign in to Cognito Forms as an organization owner or admin.
2. Click your organization's name in the top left corner, then click **Settings**.
3. Open **Integrations** and click **+ New API Key**.
4. Give the key the scopes you need (**Read** to look up forms and entries, **Write** to create or update entries, **Delete** to delete entries) and access to the forms you want to use.
5. Copy the key and paste it here. Cognito Forms only shows it once.

The Cognito Forms API needs a paid plan.
description: Online form builder for collecting and managing submissions.
triggers.entry_updated.description: Triggers when an existing form entry is updated.
triggers.entry_updated.props.webhookInst:
To use this trigger, connect your form to the webhook URL in Cognito Forms:

1. Open your form in Cognito Forms and go to **Build**, then **Form Settings**.
2. Turn on **Post JSON Data to Website**.
3. Paste the following URL into the **Update Entry Endpoint** field only:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
4. Save the form.

Cognito Forms does not sign these requests, so keep the URL private. Posting JSON data needs a paid Cognito Forms plan.
triggers.new_entry.description: Triggers when a new form entry is submitted.
triggers.new_entry.props.webhookInstruct:
To use this trigger, connect your form to the webhook URL in Cognito Forms:

1. Open your form in Cognito Forms and go to **Build**, then **Form Settings**.
2. Turn on **Post JSON Data to Website**.
3. Paste the following URL into the **Submit Entry Endpoint** field only:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
4. Save the form.

Cognito Forms does not sign these requests, so keep the URL private. Posting JSON data needs a paid Cognito Forms plan.
